description: This file defines the SSLConfigService interface and SSLContextConfig structure for managing SSL configurations in the Chromium project, including methods for retrieving SSL settings, observing configuration changes, and handling SSL context parameters.

classes.name: SSLContextConfig

classes.description: Interface for retrieving and observing global SSL configuration settings.
